node.statement: Dependency-gated lower bootstrap. This node asserts only the implication from the separately proved estimates 1.1 and 1.2; it is not eligible for acceptance while either is pending. Once 1.1 and 1.2 are validated, fix n and set a=inf_{X!=0}||gamma_n(X)||/||X|| and b=sup_{X!=0}||gamma_n(X)||/||X||. Node 1.1 gives 0<c_blk<=a<=b<=5. For every X, the exact source C*-identity, node 1.2, and the target product-norm axiom give a||X||^2<=||gamma_n(X^dagger X)||<=||gamma_n(X)^dagger gamma_n(X)||+D_sq e||X||^2<=(1+epsilon)||gamma_n(X)||^2+D_sq e||X||^2. A minimizing sequence yields a<=(1+epsilon)a^2+D_sq e. If a<1, then c_blk(1-a)<=a(1-a)<=epsilon a^2+D_sq e<=(25+D_sq)e, since epsilon<=e and a<=b<=5; if a>=1 the lower estimate is immediate. Thus a>=1-((25+D_sq)/c_blk)e. Together with validated node 1.3.1, K_norm=max{25+D_sq,(25+D_sq)/c_blk} and the common smallness ceiling give both sides of the root estimate.
